title: Mere humsafar
body:
ba waqte ruqsate hyder jo aayi roohe batool
tadap ke boli mere humsafar wasi e rasool
huwa na aapki tarha koi bhi yun maqtool
ye jaan leva musibat kiya ise bhi qabool
bas ab ye zabt e sitam khatm kijiye maula
hamein bhi apna zara waqt dijiye maula
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere hamsafar mere hyder mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar mai aayi hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
ab sang chalo ke zulm o sitam seh chuke bahot
hum bhi baghair aap ke ab reh chuke bahot
is waaste bhi ay mere shauhar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa sitam hai kaisa musibat ka hai samaa
ghash mein hai aap aur hai sar se lahoo rawan
marham lagane zakhm ke upar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ka kitna dhyan rakha mere baad mein
ehsaas e maa na hone diya mere baad mein
karne tumhara shukriya dilbar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehra hai zakhm e taygh amama hai khoon mein
dooba hua jo aap ka chehra hai khoon mein
karne ko saaf wo rukh e anwar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab saump ke hassan ko mere saath mein chalo
ab odhlo kafan ko mere saath mein chalo
faryad ye zaban par lekar mai aayi hoon
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabrao mat ke shabbar o shabbir bhi to hai
abbas bhi hai zainab e dilgeer bhi to hai
ye soch kar wasi e payambar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
firdaus mein bhi ho ke ye dukhiya udaas hai
haan aap ke baghair ye zehra udaas hai
behre sukoon ay mere hamsar mai aayi hoon
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dam gayi hayaat ko deke rehaai mai
leke gayi thi aap ke ghar se vidaai mai
phir ek baar aap ke ghar par mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aamir o kumail wo manzar ajeeb tha
godhi mein sar ko rakh ke ye kehti thi fatema
baba ke paas ashk baha kar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
author: Kumail Jafri
